units.prompt: Dress IMAGE1 neutral elf skeleton as IMAGE2 character identity. IMAGE1 alone controls skull, body and limb bone lengths and camera. Actual adult FIVE anatomical heads crown-to-sole, exclude hair/helmet protrusions. NOT four-head big-head chibi, NOT six-head elongated hero. Keep ordinary adult skull from image1 and exact same torso/leg length relationships. Bone LANDMARKS at neutral standing pose on this portrait canvas: anatomical crown y8%, chin y25%, shoulder tops y27%, pelvic joints y55%, knees y70%, ankles y85%, soles y92%. These show scale, NOT mandatory identical joint angles; bend/rotate for required stance while preserving bones. Costume/helmet closely fitted, do not inflate head inside helmet. Weapons rotate into sides, do not shrink torso to fit weapons. Elevated FRONT camera looking down30degrees, clear TOP planes of skull and both shoulders, chest/face foreshortened, chin/gaze down, NOT eyelevel with only bowed head. Exact image1 pixel density and stepped clusters, black outlines, restrained ramps. Whole body centered independently of cape/weapon, all tips visible and clear margin, transparent RGBA, no floor/base/shadow/aura/text. IMAGE2 only weapon/clothing/hair/color identity, never its skeleton. IMPORTANT: neutral image1 is BALD to expose skull; replace scalp with image2 HAIR or HELMET. Characters described with hair must NEVER be bald. Keep hair fitted around same adult skull.
